:::{#def-prefix-code}
#### Prefix code

A [binary code](source-coding.qmd#def-code) for a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$
is a **prefix code**, also called a **prefix-free code** or an **instantaneous code**,
if no codeword is the beginning of another codeword.
Writing $c(x)$ for the codeword of the value $x$,
this means that for every two different values $x$ and $x'$,
the string $c(x')$ does not start with the string $c(x)$.

:::
